title: nlist.define
nlist
description: define, store and edit nested lists

methods.description: read a file (no symbol opens dialog window)
save a file (no symbol opens dialog window)
nonzero sets to save contents with the patch

body:
[nlist.define] defines a container for multidimensional lists, where brackets set a list as an element. With a given name, the data is shared and can be accessed and changed by the other nlist objects, such as [nlist.get], [nlist.set] and [nlist.len]. Unlike [messcoll], [nlist.define] objects must not share the same name.

By default, the contents are not saved with the patch, but you can change that with the -k flag or the 'keep' message, which remains valid when reopening and resaving the patch. If a file argument is given, the keep flag and message are ignored, since the data is stored in the file.

Clicking on the object opens an editor window. Shift+click opens a dialog window to read a file, and alt+click one to save a file.
